title: Rollback command fails
objective: Fail rollback itself; reject a blindly repeated reversal with unknown effective routing.
banner: Training rehearsal - synthetic data - not a live Azure result
preconditions: Modern browser with local JavaScript; no server, framework or Azure account
A fixed retained healthy compatible known-good deployment; this is an assumption, not measured service health
One failed synthetic rollback per rehearsal requests 100% known-good and 0% candidate
Routing snapshots and reconciliation outcomes are fixed teaching data, not real operations
actions: Choose one fixed trace and record its synthetic rollback failure
Reject blind reversal, inspect effective routing, reconcile only from fresh known routing, and inspect again before verification
Check synthetic recovery as success, failure or unknown independently of command failure
Reset the current rehearsal using mouse or keyboard while retaining bounded session history

syntheticInputs.historyLifetime: In-memory page session; reset preserves all runs and the fixed allowance

expectedAssertions: The failed rollback and requested routing cannot establish observed routing or complete recovery
Blind repetition is rejected, retained in history and never issues a second rollback
Fresh inspection reconciles effective routing rather than guessing from an acknowledgement
Known-good service is retained; a reconciliation invalidates the previous observation and needs a fresh snapshot
A failed reconciliation produces failed recovery; unusable routing evidence produces unknown recovery
Success + failure + unknown equals all started synthetic rehearsals and command failures never disappear after recovery/reset
Exact input/state guards, bounded history, terminal guards, keyboard, focused errors, reset and enforced browser CSP work
limits: Rollback, faults, routing, preservation and reconciliation are DATA ONLY teaching traces, never resource, shell, process, file or network operations
Retained known-good health/compatibility is a fixed precondition; no real rollback, routing, continuity, native Azure or parent-demo certification
